phase_prompt.summary: The Priests in their standard ceremonial attire, observing and receiving.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Full body shot of a group of Ancient-Tech Priests standing solemnly in a line. They are dressed in heavy, layered ceremonial robes with metallic weaves and technological pectoral plates. Their posture is rigid and respectful. Soft, moody lighting casts long shadows, emphasizing the tactile details of their vestments and the faint glow of their sensory implants. Background suggests a vast, ancient technological interior.
